description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Catalog/SubmitCatalog. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Queues selected catalog candidates for publication or review. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use after selecting real candidates from Catalog/GetProducts. Not for discovering products, importing existing store inventory, or publishing ad-hoc URLs; use Listing/SaveBulkPublish for general URL publication. Input: CatalogSubmitRequest. Header channel is required. Each ProductsToList item contains the exact Url, Title, SubOrigin (CatalogSelection=1 or CatalogSearch=2) and optional PublishOn for individual scheduling. Optimization/review options and Origin remain supported. Legacy Id and DelaysMap remain accepted for existing first-steps clients. UserDevice is optional web telemetry; AI chat and MCP omit it. Output: Creates URL-based bulk jobs, records SubOrigin while preserving Origin=Catalog, and returns BatchId. Token/quota validation applies. Search terms: catalog submitcatalog. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically before the HGRApi request is sent.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.
